name: missed_errors_in_switch_when_using_union_af1d91d9
subject: Fix missed errors in switch when using union of literal and non-literal types (#38686) (#51373)
not_strict_reasons: no failing case added by the fix

triage.label: bug
triage.reason: The switch statement checker widened literal types to base types before the comparability check, so unions mixing literal and non-literal types missed errors such as comparing number | "hello" against "world". The fix compares the original types directly.
